terms.label: Delivery terms
terms.p1: Orders placed before 2 pm reach Riyadh, Jeddah and Dammam the next working day.
terms.p2: Other cities take two to four working days.
terms.p3: Cash on delivery is available up to SAR 2,000 per order.
terms.p4: Chilled items travel in insulated boxes and cannot be left at the door.
terms.p5: Returns are free within 14 days, unopened and with the receipt.
